description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walahamulla, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420050 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land settlement and title registration processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
